runtime_scope: Unlabelled original video, first240frames; uncached OpenCV DNN CPU inference,8threads. Excludes dataset quality evaluation; includes process/model initialization and disk logs, no GUI/rendering.16frame warmups excluded; OS caches may be warm.
scope: Earlier insect/synthetic test results have been inspected and are reused exploratory development evidence. Nine new non-insect GMOT40 category clips are predeclared confirmation, scored only after validation selection is frozen.
metric_scale: Raw exported scores are normalized; displayed HOTA/IDF1/AssA/DetA/MOTA are multiplied by 100.
aggregation: Unweighted clip means within displayed cohorts; counts summed; detector rate frame-weighted. Not official pooled scores.
